description: This file defines the EmailWritePlatformService interface, which specifies methods for creating, updating, and deleting email-related resources within the Fineract platform's email campaign infrastructure.

classes.name: EmailWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for email resource operations such as create, update, and delete within the Fineract email campaign infrastructure.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new email resource based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing email resource identified by resourceId using the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the email resource identified by resourceId.
